name: visits-checklists-readiness-escalations
objective: Replace static visit-readiness assumptions with governed event-location evidence and Business-Vertical checklist policy, followed by independent Partners readiness approval and SLA escalation.
truthOwner: DSH owns visit/check/readiness/escalation state; Control Panel owns checklist policy administration and Partners review; app-field collects evidence only.

tasks.objective: Make visit/readiness evidence policy-driven, privacy-bounded and independently reviewable.
tasks.currentProblem: Existing checks are implemented but checklist items are effectively static; the approved product disallows continuous tracking and requires configurable event proof plus independent Partners approval.
tasks.requiredChange: Add/control server-authoritative checklist templates by Business Vertical with typed/critical items; collect GPS at required start/end/event points with configurable radius and server timestamps only; use camera-first operational evidence while legal documents may use gallery/file; require Partners reviewer approval; formalize escalation severity/SLA/resolution note.
tasks.targetState: Field performs a governed visit without live tracking, critical checklist/evidence rules are policy-driven, failed/missing items block completion/readiness, Partners independently approves/rejects readiness, and escalation lifecycle is deterministic and auditable.
tasks.action: Trace field readiness policy/model/API/DB/UI and Partner readiness queues; introduce/reuse checklist-template owner, remove hardcoded duplicate lists, add location/evidence validation and review transitions, then test radius/time spoofing boundaries, wrong worker/store, concurrency, replay and rejection/return flows.
mustNotChange: لا hardcoded per-vertical checklist داخل app-field.
لا gallery كبديل افتراضي لإثبات ميداني حي.
acceptanceCriteria: Checklist template is administered centrally and selected by Business Vertical.
Only required event locations are collected; no continuous tracking code/permission flow remains for Field.
Partners reviewer independently approves/returns readiness with audit.
tasks.rollback: Forward-fix governed state/policy; never restore hardcoded shadow policy or continuous tracking.
